title: Dark Noise in 2023
content:
Hello dear reader,

    I have used Dark Noise since 2021. A long term user to say the least, and a frequent one at that. I may not be an audiophile, of sorts, but I do love some good sounding stuff.
    That being said I do adore this app. It has proven to be useful… for the times I need to study in college. For the other times when I’m just seeking some noise refuge from the everyday hustle and bustle of life. This app allows you to create sounds that could bring back even the best parts of a troubled childhood. I never really had a problem. The sounds are limited but not enough to be noticeable, and when you grow tired you can make your own mix and your own style and be able to find something, of your accord and style, to match your needs. 
    
That being said, I would like to ask the creator to incorporate two new things into their app they made for us.
    
    - 1. I would love to see a sound creator page. Something to allow people to create their own sounds and be able to “post” them for their own and others enjoyment. Wether that’s as simple as making your own with the app’s given… or maybe add in a feature that could allow you to record and display your own sounds and mix and match accordingly. This could be the dark noise sound hub we all have been waiting and looking for. 

    - 2. I would love to see an update for spatial audio. Something that I can fully immerse myself in. I like to write, maybe not professionally but for myself and for fun. Sometimes I feel that I need to be “there” to be able to fully immerse myself where I’m at and so I can really get a feel for my surroundings. We often can imagine ourselves in the world we want to be in, so why not be able to do that? I feel as if this app could do that and become a lot more than maybe it was intended by giving us some more potential to do so. With the addition of more and more headphones and surround sound systems that are capable of handling 8D audio / Spatial sound in 2023 and beyond, I think it would be great to incorporate such things into an app designed for this. 

    Just imagine yourself writing for a new book about being a pirate. You put your ‘buds in and bam. You can hear the seagulls flying over head but in all directions. title: Best Modern Sleep Noise app!
content:
I used to be satisfied with a sleep sound app that just made some white noise to give me a blank canvas for sleep. That was the olden days of iPhones, a simpler and more innocent time.

I’ve used a different sleep sound app happily for many years. It’s been collecting strikes as iOS moved forward and they haven’t. First it had no support for Shortcuts, but at the time I thought of Shortcuts as fun and new; now it’s gotten to be a part of every day I rely on. Then no AirPlay (can’t play to the HomePod mini on my nightstand), then they collect tracking data....

I finally started looking for an alternative. Turns out the other freemium sleep sound apps lack support for iOS integrations, or collect tracking data, or require a subscription, or don’t have good sounds or sound mixing (or just have nature sounds).

Then I found Dark Noise. Its UI is straightforward and clear; it supports AirPlay, Shortcuts (the best Shortcuts support I’ve seen in any sound app!), collects no data, has no subscription ask... it’s fantastic! And the sound selection has a wide variety of nature and non-nature sounds - look, I’m a city boy; I really don’t have any history of sleeping hearing frogs, and if I can hear the rain that just tells my brain that there’s an unsafe open window or a leak.

Dark Noise isn’t free; it costs five *whole* dollars. That’s about a penny and a half per day (well, night) over the first year.

But look, free isn’t free, and that’s becoming increasingly clear. With Dark Noise, it’s above board and completely transparent: I pay five bucks and I get a really good app. What a novel concept!

I had to subscribe to Apple Music to find enough Gregorian Chants, ambient electronic, or soft instrumental music to get enough music to create playlists long enough to get me through the night without a ton of repetitive music.

Not only can I mix the sounds in this app, but I can mix it with my Apple Music playlists. I have my monks chanting at the beach, during a rainstorm, by the fire. Or Nakai playing Native American Flute by a lake and waterfall, with distant thunder. Paul Horn playing flute inside the Great Pyramids, with a cat purring softly, while the wind whips across the desert. Set you dream stage with this app. Create themes for whatever you need to place yourself in the best ‘environment ‘ to sleep, read, study, or just in the background while you do whatever. 

You can create that personal sound you need to help you relax, reduce anxiety, lower blood pressure, or mask pain instead of taking more opiates. Let your imagination run wild while creating the perfect background sounds that work for you.

This app is so good, I am shocked the developer didn’t charge for the upgrade by deploying as a new app.

title: The BEST noise app!
content: And it has the best interface by far, too!

title: Need more themes
content: Can there be a library sound added. I’m a college student and use to spend many days studying there but cannot now due to COVID-19. I terribly miss those days.

title: Beta user during COVID
content:
Special shout out and support to this dev. 

They allowed users to join their beta free of charge during the COVID-19 outbreak and still continues to do frequent updates all for free. I bought the app not for access but to support them and show my appreciation for a continuous level of support, a thank you and the app is great!

title: MY CHANGED LIFE
content: FANTASTIC APP. Cured my insomnia. Tried every drug possible-only dark noise worked!

title: Overall a nice app but its not without issues.
content: I’ve been using this app for about 2 months now and although I love the overall design of the app, there are a couple of frustrating issues I’ve been unable to resolve. First, I tried creating a Siri shortcut to start playing Brown Noise on my HomePod but Siri only responds that I need to continue on my iPhone. Second, the app will randomly stop on my HomePod, usually during the middle of the night causing me to wake up. I think its a great app but until these issues are resolved I’ll be looking for something else.

title: Great sound and Responsive Developer
content:
So this might get lost in the reviews but i wanted to review and rate this app ASAP. I've been a beta tester for this app for awhile now but had no reason to rate it until today. My dad has difficulty getting to sleep, and uses a white noise app on his phone. Tried to convince him to switch to Dark Noise a couple months ago but he wouldn't. When asked he said because of all the years he spent in the military, he fell in love with "rain on a tent" and he only found one app that did it. I submitted the feedback to have that sounds added right away. And now, the app has it thanks to the developer. And my dad is now full on using the app. 

Cheers to the dev, I wasn't sure if that sound would get added, yet here we are. 5/5 all around

title: I love this app
content: The sounds are great. The design is perfect. The app icons with references to ATP, Relay.fm shows are just *chefs kiss*

title: Elegant
content: My favourite so far. Reasonably priced and very Apple-like.  I hope the developer will eventually add the ability to mix sounds, e.g., thunderstorm while in a cafe.

title: This is the best background noise app
content: This app is in a league of its own.

title: Can’t mix audio
content: You can only play one sound at a time. Noizio has had this feature since release. Please add this essential missing feature.

title: Stay focused
content: I put on noise cancellation headphones with Thunderstorm and I can stay focused for hours.

title: Really nice, but needs multiple simultaneous sounds
content: Sometimes I want to play multiple sounds together. Please add.

title: Love it!
content: Airplane interior is my favorite sound to fall asleep to. For some reason that sounds better than actual white noise. I love the variety of sounds and the app developer clearly loves and cares about this app. Looking forward to future updates and ones that will hopefully include sound mixing. :)

title: Nice little app, wish I could mix sounds together
content: It’s be nice to be able to mix multiple sounds together in the app. I’d love to be able to play rain and city sounds at the same time for example. It’s a nice app, but that feature will push to five stars for me

title: I love the spaceship engine noise
content: Sometimes when I have to get a lot of work done I turn on the Spaceship Engine and play it thru the HomePods. It is just like being on a spaceship and sometimes under high velocity it rattles in exactly the way you would expect. It is totally awesome and I love it.

title: Perfectly serves its purpose
content: Well made ambient noise app with a lot of personalization options. 10/10

title: Thank You
content: The only app I’ve found that helps with focus and concentration. Its great for loud offices, and combining it with noise canceling its a win. Kudos!

title: Pretty much Feature-Complete
content:
Fantastic app: it does exactly one thing background noise and it does that one thing exceptionally.

I would love to see (and purchase!) more sounds if they are ever added in the future. But as it exists, currently, incredibly worth the value. I use it almost daily!

title: Wanted to like it but iPhone version is buggy
content:
The iPad version works great and does everything it’s supposed to do. The iPhone version however is basically broken. UI elements disappear (like the list of sounds vanishes and won’t come back until I force close the app), and it freezes when trying to a access the settings menu.

I think the app shows promise but I needed both the iPad and iPhone version to work reliably, so unfortunately I had to request a refund.

title: Great UI!
content: Love this app because I can no longer sleep without noise, and when I am on the road this app works perfectly. The UI is as easy as it gets. And the variety of sounds is great. Excited to see what new features come in the future.

title: Amazing
content: The ability to use white noise at the same time as system audio (setting available in “Dark Labs”) has transformed the way I use white noise.

title: Dark mouse
content: The sounds are very rich. Better than most.

title: Clean interface, but missing key feature
content: I’d like the ability to mix sounds, instead of only being able to play one at a time.

title: High Quality App
content: I’ve used a number of sound-machine style apps for help sleeping while traveling. This is far and away the best. The quality of the sounds and the attention to detail in the interface adds up to be a great experience. It’s the only sound machine app I’ve found worth having.

title: Killer app for focused work…anywhere
content: With “Mix Audio” on (under Dark Labs in the app’s setting), I run the Coffee Shop noise while playing some background music (Corelli’s Concerto Grosso or one of Stafford Bawler’s game soundtracks) on noise cancelling headphones. Instant concentration during my train commute or in a shared office. Great app! (Thanks to the Cortex podcast for the plug!)

title: Amazing App
content:
I love this app, if it ever gets the ability to blend sounds together like noizio it will completely replace that app for me but for now I like to mix it up and use both. The interface is clean and easy to use and the sounds are amazing. 

My only complaint is that the app doesn’t stay in the BG very well even just opening a few apps afterwards on my XR causes it to not want to resume the audio, even when opening the app and pressing play. Also if my phone is locked and I have to pause the audio it won’t resume until I unlock my phone and press play. 

But these are minor issues to me and I am super happy with it, keep up the awesome work!

title: Seriously simply and powerful
content: Just love it. From Cortex ;)

content: Best white noise app ever

title: Campfire sound is the best
content: I use the campfire sound while studying and it just feels good and makes the process more enjoyable.

title: Really nice interface
content: Was a joy to use

title: Simply incredible.
content: Underwater and (now with update) Spaceship have helped me fall asleep consistently since Day 1 of downloading this app. I rarely sleep without it now. It’s also helped me wake up, since I become acutely aware the moment the timer stops the sound and my body naturally wakes up, miraculously 5 minutes before my alarm is set to ring. title: Best

content:
Great for boredom too besides sleep, studying and concentration hehe

Hope to hear more sounds (but not entirely like sound effects) in the next update like hums, winds, moans, Musical instruments, Ambient Lofi quality of record pops or a messy tape looping. 

something else that’s kinda underrated but not thought of and interesting to be honest

content: Great app, fantastic design. Only things missing are stereo audio — all of the sounds seem to be in mono only — and adding the ability to mix different sounds together. With those two things it would be perfect.

title: Sublime
content:
Beyond the magnificent user interface, there are exquisitely curated sounds. That’s simply what Dark Noise is all about. It is extraordinary. 

And then (this is key) the dev of Dark Noise is responsive. An email query about an issue gets addressed rapidly; counts for a lot in my book. 

Things happen and not always within the control of the developer. Always prefer to check-in with the dev directly before posting an issue or question here.

content: While I appreciate this app’s pretty stellar UI, the actual core functionality of Dark Noise—playing sounds—is really poor. The sounds are low quality and really tinny, and they need to be played at too high a volume. When the developer addresses this, I will gladly return.

title: Can’t mix sound together
content: I didn’t realize this app only let’s you play one sound at a time. Every other noise app lets you combine sounds

title: Simple yet powerful
content: This app is simple yet provides everything you could ever need from a white noise app. It is clean, has many diverse sounds and absolutely mesmerizing icon animations to watch while you listen. My personal favorite is the spaceship.

title: Great for sleeping
content: I use this app in a Siri Shortcuts goodnight routine to turn off all the lights, make sure garage is closed, set DND on phone and play some “noise” output to a HomePod when going to bed. Great app out the door and getting better. Dev is really responsive too. (Maybe in future, open a store in app to get more sounds!)

title: It’s perfect!
content: This is a solid foundation for a powerful app that does one simple thing very well. It looks like there are some great features in the works. Very happy to have this and super happy about the support for Siri Shortcuts. Thanks!

title: This app is perfect!
content:
I’m a huge fan of using noises like these to concentrate at work or relax while reading. I have a playlist of thunderstorms that I normally listen to but this app has replaced that. I use it everyday and really enjoy the consistency. 

I’d love for more thunderstorm sounds and at a higher audio quality. Other than that I love it.

title: If you want what’re noise, this is the one.
content: This is the well-designed white noise app that I’ve been waiting for. Good sounds, clean aesthetic, and no junky adds.

title: Loving this
content: This app is absolutely amazing! I love having some kind of background noise when I’m working but find audiobooks, podcasts, and even music can be too distracting. It’s nice having an assortment of sounds on phone, ready to go.

title: Great design and sounds!
content: This is just the simple noise app I was looking for — easy to use, and a classic selection of sounds. I love the ability to set up a widget for easy access. The only feature I’d love to see in a future release is to have the noise automatically fade out when interrupted by an alarm or sound from another app. Thanks!

title: Could add more
content: y’all should add ocean/beach, windy forest

title: Fantastic
content: This app is legit amazing! Exactly what I have been looking for,I use it for many different situations! 🙏🏼

title: Simple, straight to the point
content:
Great app, great price point, does what I need it to do without a lot of work, tweaking settings, or menu diving. 

Since it is easier than ever before, please make iPad, iPod, Apple Watch, and Mac compatible companion apps for Dark Noise as well! I’d buy it.

title: Sound quality is off
content: I agree with scampercom about the sound quality being off.  The sounds sound thinned out.  I use in-ear headphones (not Apple’s) to help blocked out co-workers when trying to concentrate.  I usually listen to music but sometimes that can get tiresome and I prefer white noise.  This app, though I really like the selection, probably wouldn’t help.  The sound quality from other apps like Noisli and Noizio are better, with Wildfulness being the absolute best with 3D sound.  I can mix sounds with Noisli but the app hasn’t been updated in a year or so and you can hear the looping.  Noizio is updated, has more sounds than Noisli, but you can hear the looping and it requires so many in app purchases to expand the library.  Wildfulness, Wildfulness 2, and it’s 3rd counterpart Sonas Island (or something like that) has beyond amazing sound quality.  You can hear the looping with a few sounds but it’s biggest flaw for me is the lack of variety.  It’s ALL nature sounds.  There are other apps I have tried but most were unnecessarily complicated or not worth mentioning.  This app is good for it’s simplicity, ease of use, features, and variety, but unfortunately not it’s sound quality.

title: Definitely a work of passion
content: I can tell a lot of effort went into this app and it wasn’t just completed as quickly as possible. The animations make it feel fluid and responsive. In essence this app is a very simple concept that doesn’t require all the fancy artwork for it to accomplish its purpose. But it completes the experience. Well done!

title: Real quality sounds
content: I was surprised how great the sound is. It has a timer, a clock, its customizable. There's a lot of detail in this app.

title: Pretty decent. Needs a mixer.
content: I'd like the ability to combine the different tracks available and adjust their levels to create a multilayered noise experience. I assumed the feature would be there already. Fantastic sounds though. Just don't want to be limited to only one at a time.

title: Great app, quality of recordings could be improved.
content:
First, this app is a great example on how to stay simple and fit well with the ecosystem. 

The UI is excellent, and it is super easy to use. 

👏👏👏

Bravo

That said, I feel like the recording of some of the sounds are a bit sub par. I saw on reddit that you wanted to keep the download size small, and I totally agree, but it would be nice to have an in app option to fetch higher quality recordings. 

Side note: some of the sounds would pop a bit better with dummy head recording, have you looked into this?

title: Love it
content: It’s simple, beautiful, and useful.

title: Gorgeous, wonderful
content: This app is so lovingly crafted and thoughtfully detailed. If you have any interest at all in controlling your personal soundscape, this is your first and last stop.

title: Best White / Dark noise generator!
content:
What I love: 

* tons of options so we can have exactly the sounds we prefer
* supports all the latest iOS features (huge deal) 
* amazing animations and visual style combined with haptics. The app really feels alive when you use it 
* works exactly as promised
* lots of settings and customization

10/10 - this is the background noise app you NEED.

title: Awesome sound app
content: On the surface, it’s an absolute ball to play with and use.  Dig a little deeper and quality touches stick out (sound that doesn’t loop noticeably), the icon animations for each sound.  Awesome.  It’s been so long since I just had fun with a non game app...till Dark Noise.  Can’t go on though, have to get back to playing with this app...

title: Flawless.
content: Dark Noise is not just the best white noise app I’ve ever found, but one of the best APPS I’ve ever found—period. The amount of sounds to choose from, the range of style customization, and the smoothness/creativity of each animation make this app so much fun to use. You can tell each element was considered carefully. I highly recommend checking this one out.

title: Simple beautiful and highly functional
content: I could use this all day at work... On my commute on bus or train... To relax in bed... Well worth the nominal one time fee... Grab it!

title: Delightful
content:
I only use an ambient noise app occasionally, but Dark Noise is one of those apps that's so well conceived and designed, with such a delightful sensibility, that I have a feeling I'll be dipping into it again and again just for kicks. 

Support indie developers, especially this one. You'll be glad you spent the four bucks.

title: Beautiful design
content: Dark Noise has all the features you would expect in a noise app, plus some things you might not expect (like Siri shortcuts). Best of all, the interface is gorgeous, customizable, and fun. Overall am amazing app.

title: Best noise app I’ve found
content:
I’ve been looking a sustainable, good looking, and quality noise app that supported Siri shortcuts. 

Only two things keep it from being 5 stars for me. I would love to be able to mix sounds. Crickets and campfire mmmm. Secondly, the ability to enable the timer in Shortcuts would be lovely. I want to set a bedtime shortcut to turn off certain lights, play brown noise, and fade out after a couple hours. That sort of thing.

title: Incredible, really!
content: It’s tough to make an app this good. Beautiful design and fun to use. I’ve been waiting for it’s release for a long time and it was well worth the wait!

title: A Top 10 App
content:
Like sleep in a bottle. I have used this app both for relaxation before bed, and for finding the “zone” while working from home.
This app distinguishes itself from all my other white noise apps (I know, I’m weird.) with personalization, a variety of mesmerizing sounds, and an overall feel that is one of a kind.

title: So good it should be built in
content: Dark Noise is so easy to use and such a good citizen of iOS that it makes you feel like the iPhone should *come with* a Noise app, and this should be it. A good noise app and a pair of headphones is the best defense against insanity, and I think Dark Noise is going to keep me sane for a long time. (Don’t worry, I already lodged a request for a starship engine noise 😉)

title: Indispensable
content: I rely on a white noise generator as a coping mechanism for misophonia, and this app is such a joy to use that it helps reduce anxiety even more in those situations. There are so many clever design considerations, like a layout for one-handed use, special care to mask when a sound loops, an overall app size that’s a fraction of competitor apps, and more. Thank you Charlie!

title: Elegant white noise app
content: It’s immediately obvious that a lot of thought and care went into creating what may seem to be a simple app. The attention to detail and playful design sets this white noise app apart from its competitors.
